threadStructure: parent overview -> four experiment replies -> two previous-experiment replies -> four reference-site replies

parent.text:
MiniMax-H3 Experiment Lab、Kijai LightX2V 4-stepをRTX 4090で検証したぞ！！！

T2V / I2V × er_sde / sa_solverを同じDocker Compose環境で実行。
親投稿には4本を同時比較した概要動画、返信には各実験の動画・プロンプト・全パラメータ・処理時間・検査結果を添付する🔥

同条件ではsa_solverがer_sdeより速く、T2V / I2VともOOMなし。詳細はこのスレッドへ。

media.provenance: HyperFrames render from the four real generated RTX 4090 Docker Compose outputs; no replacement media

replies.text:
【実験1｜T2V / er_sde】

Prompt:
A calm cinematic sunrise over a quiet Japanese mountain lake, gentle mist drifting across the water, slow camera movement, natural ambient birds and soft wind, no text, five seconds.

Parameters:
GPU: RTX 4090 / Compose: h3-4090
Resolution: 1344×768, 158 frames, 24fps
Base: minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
Text encoder: qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
VAE: official FP16 video + FP32 audio
Kijai full LoRA: strength 0.75
Steps: 4 / Sampler: er_sde / Scheduler: simple
EasyCache: reuse 0.3 / start 0.2 / end 0.9
Seed: 2026080801

Result:
Inference 362.48 sec / runner wall 365.71 sec
Output 6.583333 sec / H.264 + AAC stereo
OOMなし / blackdetect 0
Output SHA-256: B0540FE30DC549ABA6E14B3A36270BFE7068CC76F81B2763C0949CEDD92E233E
Benchmark: h3-b87755af-c053-42c3-8c49-6c628013b124.md
